_source.description: Baseline adjusted down on purpose after PR #561 (issue #991): Kimi-K3 now runs on the unified KV pool by default, and the pooled KDA path is expected to be slower until it is optimized (with TPU_VLLM_ENABLE_UNIFIED_BLOCK_POOL=0 the pre-#561 numbers come back, but that flag excludes prefix caching). Values from nightly ci build 1003 on main dd9db189 (median TTFT 995 ms -> 1573 ms, TPOT 18.95 -> 19.2 ms, 452 -> 434 tok/s); previous_values kept for when the pooled path is optimized.
